tasks.label: Build PIC24
tasks.command: xc16-gcc -mcpu=24FJ128GA010 -omf=elf -Wl,--script=p24FJ128GA010.gld -I inc src/adc.c src/int.c src/kernel.c src/main.c src/mem.c src/message.c src/pwm.c src/scheduler.c src/sync.c src/timer.c src/uart.c src/user_app.c -o firmware.elf && xc16-bin2hex firmware.elf
